hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.swift$' && swiftformat "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.swift$' && command -v swiftlint > /dev/null && swiftlint lint --quiet "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
